# Theo Martin

> Independent consultant, coding agents in production. Eight years of ML and production LLM systems, five of them at Amazon, then Tech Lead of the Core AI team at Akeneo. Sells four formats: an agentic setup audit, an in-house workshop, office hours, and building an agent system, priced publicly in euros excluding VAT.
